verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-protection and chargeback SaaS that exposes a REST API, webhooks and SDKs. It is not an AI agent or tool-using host, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent or AI assistant inside the product that could consume tools from MCP servers, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
